title: SilentScan corpus manifest
description: CLAUDE.md corpus rules: repo URL, commit SHA pinned, license, which paths contain DDL vs procs, declared/assumed collation.

name.description: Short identifier used in reports and file paths, e.g. 'my-project'.

commitSha.description: Pinned full commit SHA - never track a moving branch.

ddlPaths.description: Repo-relative glob paths containing table/view/index DDL.

procPaths.description: Repo-relative glob paths containing stored procedures/functions.

declaredCollation.description: The database's declared default collation if known from a CREATE DATABASE statement or project docs. Null if unknown - CLAUDE.md: never guess a collation.

notes.description: Anything else worth recording: dialect-sniffing caveats, excluded subpaths, etc.

templateSubstitutions.description: Literal text tokens this repo's DDL/proc files use as template placeholders (e.g. DNN Platform's {databaseOwner}) mapped to their conventional substitution value, applied before ScriptDOM parses each file. Omit or null if the repo needs no substitution.
